images.label: MonolithAndKey
images.prompt: A mist-shrouded ancient stone monolith covered in glowing arcane glyphs, floating black fog coils around its base; cyberpunk/sci-fi hybrid style with intricate biomechanical texture and holographic shimmer; centered composition with low-angle view emphasizing monument's scale; dramatic chiaroscuro lighting—soft celestial glow from a floating key embedded in the center contrasting with deep indigo shadows and faint crimson rim-light from unseen watchers.

images.label: GuardiansConfrontation
images.prompt: Two figures back-to-back in a swirling void of sentient darkness: a woman in ornate nano-weave armor wielding a plasma-edged sword, a man in tactical exo-suit raising a humming blue energy rifle; anime-inspired sci-fi style with dynamic linework and volumetric fog; medium-wide shot with diagonal tension, figures silhouetted against pulsing glyph-light; moody bioluminescent lighting—crimson eye-glow from shadow-construct enemies surrounding them, cool cyan shield aura radiating faintly.

images.label: ShadowGuardianGrasp
images.prompt: A towering biomechanical guardian emerging from abyssal darkness—obsidian scales, crackling green flame eyes, massive clawed hand gripping a man's wrist; sci-fi cinematic style with hyper-detailed surface texture and particle-laced atmosphere; tight framing focusing on the clenched hand and strained facial expression; high-contrast lighting—intense emerald highlights on scales, deep void-black background, radiant golden-white light flaring from nearby runes on a distant monolith.
